first.rationale: I currently intend to test simplifying onboarding because completion and activation are both declining, and improving time-to-value is more likely to produce sustainable qualified revenue than broadly matching competitor pricing. I will verify the onboarding result and the SMB pricing result to assess the tradeoff between durable activation gains and immediate competitive pressure before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, given the current 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline. The verified source shows a 13% completion lift, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and 3% higher 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: although it lifted qualified revenue 18% short term, 30-day retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Measure activation, completion, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and retention, while preserving uncertainty about longer-term effects.
